_comment: Content Wave C1: the Liscor sewers canonical walkthrough. Loads the near_sewers FIXTURE (post_tutorial_street shape + heard_about_cisterns pre-banked, so the grate-gate is open -- C3 banks that accomplishment from Olesm for real) via title Continue, positioned two steps north of the grate approach. Enters via the REAL sewer_grate interact (door_when seam), walks the sewers, reads two flavor props, clears the sewer_vermin trash pack (autoplay), then climbs the exit ladder back to the street. Proves: the grate-gate transition, the sewers dark mood + map render + always-on ambience, prop toasts, the new sewer_vermin encounter/arena, and the exit door. Fixture rng_state (9) governs -- no --seed search. NOTE: the shield_spider nest is placed but NOT fought here (that is Quest 1 / Task C3's job; interact-only, off this path). PLAYTEST FEATURE 3 EXTENSION: after landing, casts [Light] on the ambient path (hotbar_2) to conjure the PC-following arcane glow that makes the dark sewers navigable -- proving the new light_active sim flag, the ui_pc_light_rendered{active:true} UI confirmation, the follows-you toast copy, and a LIT vs UNLIT screenshot pair (00_sewers_landing = unlit, 00b_sewers_lit = lit). The near_sewers fixture was given `light` in player_skills for this (see its comment); the cast is exploration-only and fight-determinism-neutral, so the vermin autoplay is unchanged.

steps._comment: Down 1 selects Continue, confirm loads the near_sewers fixture.
== ENTER via the real grate ==. Down 2 to (15,11), then right 1 bumps the sewer_grate (16,11, blocked by the prop) so we end at (15,11) facing right, ready to interact.
door_when gate is MET (heard_about_cisterns banked) -> the grate opens: open_toast, then transition to the sewers landing.

payload_contains.text: You set your shoulder to the grate. The rust gives with a shriek, and cold air breathes up out of the dark. Down you go.

steps._comment: Sewers atmosphere: dark mood pin, cave map render, and the 3 always-on ambience emitters (2 pond_glints on the channels + dust_motes). Whole-run scans (atmosphere_check idiom) -- these fire from the map-change rebuild.
UNLIT read: the sewers landing at (2,2) before any [Light] cast -- pair with 00b_sewers_lit below (dark cave grade, no PC glow).
steps.name: 00_sewers_landing

steps._comment: == PLAYTEST FEATURE 3: cast [Light] on the PC (ambient path) mid-sewers. The near_sewers fixture carries `light` in player_skills, so the field hotbar renders it at slot 2 (slot 1 = innate [Basic Cleaning]). Pressing hotbar_2 while facing a non-light-prop cell takes use_skill_field's field_ambient path (no sewers prop carries requires_skill==light), which sets light_active and conjures the PC-following glow. Proves: the ambient skill_used stream (target empty), the new follows-you toast copy, ui_pc_light_rendered{active:true}, and the round-trippable sim flag. ==

payload_contains.text: [Light] — A steady white orb rises to follow you, throwing back the dark.

steps._comment: ui_pc_light_rendered{active:true} fires synchronously BEFORE the toast (inside the same skill_used emit), so scan the whole log rather than wait past the toast cursor.
LIT read: same landing cell, now with the warm PC glow attached -- the LIT half of the pair against 00_sewers_landing.
steps.name: 00b_sewers_lit

steps._comment: Re-cast while already lit: the ambient toast fires again but NO second light attaches (world reconcile is idempotent) and the flag stays true.
steps.name: hotbar_2

payload_contains.text: [Light] — A steady white orb rises to follow you, throwing back the dark.

steps._comment: == Phosphor moss (5,1): right 3 to (5,2), up 1 bumps the moss so we face it. ==

payload_contains.text: Phosphor moss clings to the brick, glowing a sick, cold green. Cool to the touch, and it hisses faintly when your shadow crosses it.

steps._comment: == Sewer vermin (7,2): right 2 from (5,2) bumps the encounter at (7,2), ending at (6,2) facing right. Interact starts the fight. ==
Dismiss the victory banner (non-tutorial arena, so no tutor line to confirm through -- same confirm-then-hide as crate_fight).
steps.name: confirm

steps._comment: == Drainage marker (5,3): left 1 to (5,2), down 1 bumps the marker so we face it. ==

payload_contains.text: An old Drake drainage marker, its glyphs half-swallowed by grime. You can just make out a map of channels — and a fresh scratch, shaped like a spider, gouged over the third cistern.

steps._comment: == EXIT: back to (2,2), up 1 bumps the sewer_exit ladder (2,1). Interact climbs back to the street beside the grate (15,11). ==
